SIGNALS.name: News from Google
SIGNALS.summary: Google says Gemini 4 Neon is its third Gemini model released in eight days, and that Tasks is expanding in the Gemini app.

SIGNALS.name: OpenAI
SIGNALS.summary: OpenAI says ecommerce and online service businesses based outside the U.S. can now claim their business and publish agents in ChatGPT.

SIGNALS.name: Google AI
SIGNALS.summary: Google AI recaps two weeks of shipping, led by Gemini 4 Neon for software engineering and science, plus Gemini 4 Hydrogen.

SIGNALS.name: Anthropic
SIGNALS.summary: Anthropic says it priced its IPO at $83 per share, with trading on Nasdaq expected to begin on November 19. The SEC declared the registration effective on November 18.

SIGNALS.name: OpenAI
SIGNALS.summary: OpenAI shares new data on AI's role in its own research: researchers' AI use keeps rising and agents finish longer tasks, while humans stay central and spend more time on safety work.

SIGNALS.name: Google DeepMind
SIGNALS.summary: Google DeepMind begins rolling out Gemini 4 Neon, positioned between Carbon and Hydrogen, for software engineering, knowledge work and science tasks.

SIGNALS.name: Sam Altman
SIGNALS.summary: Sam Altman says OpenAI's 6.2 Sol and Astra models are out, calls them token-efficient, and highlights the ultrafast mode of 6.2 Sol.

SIGNALS.name: Microsoft AI
SIGNALS.summary: Microsoft AI announces seven new models at Ignite, pitched as secure, aligned frontier intelligence at a fraction of current prices.

SIGNALS.name: Lightspeed India
SIGNALS.summary: Lightspeed India congratulates Sarvam on Token Factory, which hosts Sarvam and open-weight models on GPUs in India to address data residency needs.
